title: Kusarigama
description: Every time you play [blue]3[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, deal [blue]6[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks the number of Attack cards played in a single turn. The relic's counter resets at the end of each turn, and displays progress toward triggering (e.g., 0/3, 1/3, 2/3).
